data.one_liner: Firebase UI widgets for Google OAuth authentication
data.what_it_does: Provides pre-built UI widgets and integration for Google sign-in using Firebase Authentication and OAuth. It simplifies adding Google authentication flows to Flutter applications.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app using Firebase Authentication
You want pre-built UI components for Google sign-in rather than building custom widgets
avoid_when: You are not using Firebase in your project
you require a custom bespoke login UI for Google sign-in
strengths: Provides ready-to-use widgets for Google sign-in
Maintained as part of the official Firebase UI packages
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the Firebase ecosystem
Limited customization of the internal UI flow without writing custom wrappers
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring Firebase in your project and setting up Google Sign-In credentials for target platforms.

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want direct control over the Google sign-in logic and custom UI implementation without depending on Firebase UI components.
